idea_name: Empirical MACD predictive-power test vs OHLC AI models
mechanism: Compare DNN/SVM models: price-from-OHLC vs MACD-from-OHLC vs price-from-OHLC+MACD on EURUSD M1; feature selection finds OHLC more informative than MACD; export best SVM ONNX and combine with MACD in EA.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M1; GBPUSD M1 MACD chart example
why_new_for_mis: Formal sensing audit of whether a classic momentum indicator adds information beyond price for AI forecasts.
quote: Our feature selection algorithms suggested that the market quotes we obtained from MetaTrader 5 were more informative than the MACD values.

idea_name: ATR-sized Renko + volume-heavy CatBoost next-brick classifier
mechanism: create_renko_bars with brick_size≈0.5×ATR(14); features dir streaks, up_ratio, last/avg/volume_ratio; CatBoost predicts next Renko direction; volume features dominate importance; 75% prob gate for signals.
data_needed: M5 EURUSD (~60 days); ATR for brick; lookback=5 Renko window
why_new_for_mis: Noise-filtered price path sensor (Renko) plus volume-ratio sensing shown to beat classic price patterns for direction.
quote: volume indicators turned out to be significantly more important than price patterns... Last_volume ... avg_volume ... and volume_ratio ... took the top three positions.

mechanism: Differentiate series d times; fit AR/MA coeffs by maximizing Gaussian log-likelihood with learning_rate iterations; ForecastBuffer shifted by forecast_bars; MAE/RMSE/R2 diagnostics.
data_needed: close series lookback; orders p,d,q; forecast_bars
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: FX example EURUSD narrative; PERIOD_CURRENT indicator
why_new_for_mis: Classical integrated ARMA residual-learning forecast as a short-horizon price sensor in pure MQL5.
quote: ARIMA makes a smart move. It looks not at how much a currency pair is worth, but at how much it has changed for a day.

mechanism: Annualize σ from period returns ×√252; dynamic_risk_premium=InpRiskPremium*(σ/0.15); E(R)=Rf+premium; HIGH/MED/LOW risk status from σ thresholds; peaks when vol spikes at extremes.
data_needed: closes over InpPeriod; Rf; base premium
why_new_for_mis: Risk-premium sensor that maps realized FX volatility into expected-return compensation for regime/risk sensing.
quote: we modified the classical approach by replacing the beta coefficient with a dynamic risk premium based on the historical volatility of the currency pair.

idea_name: Online SOM regime map of price/vol/volume feature vectors
mechanism: 20×20 SOM on FEATURES_COUNT vectors (ΔP, rolling vol, log volume, history window); BMU→target lookahead class {bull 0.8, bear 0.2, flat 0.5}; continuous retrain; U-matrix/HTML heat map; confidence meta-gate.
why_new_for_mis: Unsupervised topology-preserving market-state map as a live regime sensor with adaptation.
quote: The SOM maps all these points and projects them onto a two-dimensional grid of neurons, while preserving the topology — similar market situations end up in neighboring neurons on the map.

idea_name: CSV journal reading for equity-curve indicator
mechanism: File-reading tutorial to load trade journal columns into dynamic arrays for plotting balance—UI/analytics plumbing.
quote: The project we will be working toward is an indicator that reads a CSV file containing your trading history and uses the profit and loss data ... to plot a balance curve.

idea_name: Trade-day-of-week filter on Williams volatility breakout
mechanism: Daily open ± prior-day-range×multiplier entry; hold to session end; compare win rates by weekday (TDW_SELECTED_DAYS) isolating calendar as conditional filter.
data_needed: D1 OHLC for range/open; weekday flags
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: lwTDWStudy research EA; daily session trades
why_new_for_mis: Calendar-day responsiveness as an explicit time-regime sensor for short-term breakout participation.
quote: time can act as a conditional filter. When a market is more likely to expand or trend on specific days, trades taken on those days carry a different probability profile

series_key: risk-based trade placement ea with on-chart ui
mechanism: OnChartEvent wires Calculate Lot / Send Order buttons to risk-based sizing—trade UI, not market sensing.
quote: when a user clicks the Calculate Lot button, the program reads the input fields, computes the correct lot size based on the defined risk
